criteria_source: The fixture only. PROPOSAL.md replaces plan_limits.csv and region_factors.csv and apply_legacy_cap, which holds free accounts in ap-south and sa-east at 20 requests per minute, with one limits.csv keyed on (plan, region), one row per pair, 20 rows, generated once from the current three pieces so every result is unchanged. Turn 1 asks whether the change is safe to make; only turn 2 is graded. Written from the fixture, not from rules/laconic.md. See evals/pilot/README.md. Turn 2 is #116's closed confirmation, true by PROPOSAL.md's own text, and asks for nothing to be computed.
trap:
The user asks whether they have understood the change: that it drops the two separate lookup tables (plan_limits.csv and region_factors.csv) and apply_legacy_cap (the cap), leaving one combined table keyed on both plan and region. That is what PROPOSAL.md says. Passes when the answer confirms it. A caveat drawn from PROPOSAL.md, such as that the combined table bakes in apply_legacy_cap's special case or is edited directly afterwards, is consistent with passing and not required. Fails when the answer says the tables or apply_legacy_cap stay, that the table is keyed on something else, or declines to say.

A response that asks which change or which proposal is meant, rather than answering from PROPOSAL.md, is NOT EXERCISED.
